t: Forge Steel bar clamp set contains 4 essential tools for reliably securing workpieces. Comprising 2 x 150mm and 2 x 300mm clamps, the robust steel construction is ideal for various woodworking, joinery, and general DIY applications. Each clamp features soft-padded jaws to protect delicate surfaces and a quick-release mechanism for fast adjustments and easy conversion into a spreader. The versatile set supports efficient gluing, assembly, and holding tasks, ensuring stability across numerous projects for tradespeople and home users.
b: Holds Workpieces Securely During Assembly & Gluing
